RULES IN FORCE: lead + at most TWO helpers; merges are SQUASH pinned to the verified head (gh pr merge N --squash --match-head-commit SHA); close a claim only after gh pr view N --json state says MERGED; a helper that is cut off by a usage limit is resumed with SendMessage (its work is saved); the server image publishes from main on every server merge and the migration runner tracks versions as a SET (out-of-order numbers are safe); never ; engineering checks are worded 'verified on an emulator against VM 108 updated to sha-<commit> (engineering check, not the release-candidate pair)'. THE BENCH: VM 108 (Proxmox) is RUNNING on purpose at its DHCP address (find it by MAC bc:24:11:7b:09:a2; it was 192.168.11.123), image sha-7c7fa60 (before the N-11 merges and P1-26): SHUT IT DOWN when the checks are done (ssh proxmox qm shutdown 108) and log it in local/homelab-changes-2026-11-13.md; the emulator encore_a07 is OFF (restart without wipe keeps the sign-in; it is signed in as the test account qaowner = the same account as the owner's phone: Private listening is ON, make no likes/edits/downloads from it; slow under load: 'System UI isn't responding' -> choose Wait); the debug APK build 150 (main dbe63d0, versionCode 150, x86_64 included) is archived in releases-archive/build-150-dbe63d0/ and must NOT be installed on the owner's A35 (a different signature would cost him his downloads); his A35 is on build 144. NEXT consolidated engineering check (ONE new APK built after the N-11 phone half merges) covers N-20, the lost pause, N-22, N-24, N-25, N-23a, P1-26: needs a separate test MEMBER account on VM 108 for downloads (try local/logins/encore-vm108-qafriend-login.txt first; see local/credentials-map.md).
